source_note: Etemadi关于强大数定律的证明
english_source_note: Etemadi's Proof of the Strong Law of Large Numbers
callout_id: Etemadi关于强大数定律的证明#1
english_title: Strong Law of Large Numbers, Kolmogorov, 1930
statement_en: Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n,\ldots$ be a sequence of independent and identically distributed random variables, and assume $E(|X_i|)<\infty$. If $E(X_1)=\mu$ and $S_n=\sum_{k=1}^{n}X_i$, then $$\frac{S_n}{n}\xrightarrow{a.e.}\mu.$$
prerequisites: independent and identically distributed random variables
callout_body: $X_1,...,X_n,...$是一列独立同分布的随机变量，并且期望存在，即$E(|X_i|)<\infty$。那么如果假设$E(X_1)=\mu,S_n=\sum_{k=1}^{n}X_i$那么$$\frac{S_n}{n}\xrightarrow{a.e.}\mu$$
